title: stage nested pipelines
shortDescription: Two stage layers, one with a bloom pipeline of its own, composed by a RootRenderPipeline
description: The root `StageRenderer` of the `Display` holds two layers: a nested `StageRenderer` with the world stage, and the UI stage directly. The world renderer has a three.js `RenderPipeline` of its own with a bloom from `createBloomOutputNodeBuilder()`; the UI is drawn without post-processing on top. A `RootRenderPipeline` on the root composes the passes of all children additively and makes the one draw to the canvas — the pattern the stage cheat-sheet calls *Mode E*.
